Head-sha: `6d1f83cb95b683a94b9455f24adad40331fc6108`
Local-runs: none
Scope: (hits: `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md`, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md`) + (cited: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md`, `references/landing-operations.md` L9, `references/lanes/spec.md` L9-22, `references/triage-duties.md` L15/L43-44, `references/dispatch-runbook.md` L77/L151/L185-188, `AGENTS.md` PD12 L246-252 and Post-Task step 4 L1037-1039, `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` (header L170-265, CEILINGS), `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` L417-433, `scripts/pm/check-governed-prose.mjs`, `scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs` L35, `.github/workflows/lint.yml` L1056/L1066/L1512, `packages/services/service-automation/src/screen-input-contract.ts` L76/L143-148 and `screen-input-contract.test.ts` L13/L65, card #30273 body + comments 6650133448/6672474625/6672881163, #30178 body + comments 6641856071/6647305770/6647359070/6648655128, #17306 comment 5651909056, PR #30736 body/files/check-runs)

### ① Derived judgments

- Diff is 4 files, +13/-13, every line under `.claude/**`; no `packages/**`, `scripts/**`, `AGENTS.md` or `.github/**` hunk (`git diff --stat origin/main...FETCH_HEAD`). Merge-base `ab44ec94` = the claim's premise commit (comment 6672474625); the six commits main gained since do not touch these four files (`git diff --stat FETCH_HEAD...origin/main -- .claude/` is empty).
- Wanted 1 encoded, correct: execution-duties.md L12 (grep the declared surface, sources and tests, for `ruling`/`Ruling-ref`/`maintainer`/`⛔` before writing the Ruling section), L13 (card rulings and hit-cited rulings enter verbatim, id + sentence; 「无裁决」 only on a zero-hit grep; hits that cite no ruling are recorded as a count — an extension consistent with the card's "only when that grep is empty"), L128 (third zone ⛔ must not contradict the Ruling section), L129 (a seat that thinks a ruling should move writes it in the order and sends it to a review thread before dispatch, ⛔ never through the dev), L130 (fence names `packages/spec/src/**` prose in scope when a carried ruling must be restated, ⛔ no blanket ban). The three-zone structure at L127 is unchanged; os-dev.md L183-184 still names the same three zones.
- Wanted 2 encoded, correct: os-dev.md L350 (shape = Zod shape, error-code ledger, authorable key add/remove/tombstone, published export ⇒ `needs_decision`), L351 (prose = jsdoc, `.describe`, `content/docs/**`, regenerated mirrors, and only when it restates a ruling the Ruling section carries ⇒ not a fork), L352 (same PR, ruling id in the PR body, contract-review record owed; ⛔ never reverse a ruling; a fix contradicting one still stops). L349 (unspecified contract decisions: do not guess) and L353-354 (`needs_decision` with options into `open_questions`) are unchanged, so "needs_decision still goes to a review thread" (SKILL.md L220, unchanged) holds. Rule 5 at L77 now routes the "fix at the spec" arm to the stop section instead of implying a free spec edit — consistent with AGENTS.md PD12 L252 ("Change the spec only when the spec itself is genuinely…").
- The stop rule cannot be read as a shape licence: L351 is gated on "只复述裁决区所载裁决" (restates a carried ruling), L350 sends any shape change to `needs_decision` unconditionally, and L352 forbids reversal and stops a contradicting fix. A dev with no carried ruling has no prose arm at all. Correct.
- SKILL.md L217 `契约形状` matches L211's existing wording (「公开契约形状」) and triage-duties.md L43-44 (`契约形状提案`); same term across the three files. L162 `domain:spec` row unchanged (only L217 in the SKILL.md hunk); L218-219's "纯文档措辞更正(无契约声明改动)" non-escalation class still reads coherently beside it.
- Worked example (runbook L217-219) is accurate to the record: `screen-input-contract.ts` cites "ruling A′" on origin/main L76/L143/L146/L229 and its test at L13/L65/L132; comment 5651909056 is headed "a non-number for a numeric field is refused, never silently passed" (quoted verbatim at L218); the original order 6647305770 recorded "Ruling section: no maintainer ruling; triage first-touch audit 6641856071" and its route was "coerce a finite numeric string" (card body, and the dev's report 6647359070 names it as "the order's suggested route") = 「有限数字串转数字」 at L219; ruling 6648655128 confirms the route is refuse (A) and names the spec prose sites as in scope with no Zod shape change. The example carries a comment id, not a `#NNN` citation (id-lint pattern is `/#[0-9]{3,}/`, check-skill-id-lint.mjs L35), and runbook L77/L151 already use bare comment ids for `Ruling-ref:`.
- Deleted lines, each checked for another home: execution-duties old L124 (tier-resolution pointer) — the authority sentence lives in os-dev.md L12-13 (points at the `check:agent-model-declared` header); old L140 ("named list is a hint, dev re-derives; re-verify line-level assertions") — dev half at os-dev.md L140/L145-147 and execution-duties L139 (gate list from `dispatch-gates --commands`), PM half at L137 (lists/paths/line numbers taken from the tree at dispatch), L140 (code hazard assertions need a reading), L141 (relayed counts re-measured or marked unverified); old L172 (notification replay: identity before content) — runbook L187-188 carries the full rule. os-dev old L78 ("forcing a PR onto a dead premise is the failure") is the rationale of L80; old L262 (SIGTERM mid-mutation) is the rationale of L261's `trap` hard line (platform fact still at L104); old L320 ("eaten marker invisible to the PM scan") is the rationale of L319/L323. Runbook old L65 (label change refreshes `updated_at`) explains L64's sweep; what enters the sweep is defined by triage-duties.md L15; old L89 (`chore: version packages` title) is rationale for L87 "title is never the criterion" (AGENTS.md L319/L328 keep the title); old L166 ("middle state most valuable") is rationale for L162/L164-165. No duty or prohibition lost.
- Line ceilings: all four files 405/319/245/188 on base, main and head (measured); no `scripts/pm/**` hunk, so CEILINGS untouched. Every added/changed line ≤ 120 bytes (measured 84-119 B); runbook and execution-duties max line = 120 B on head. Ratchet, id-lint and governed-prose run in `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (lint.yml L1056/L1066/L1512), green on this head.
- Tier: `.claude/**` of objectstack is the one Tier S register row (check-governed-merges.mjs L429-433); `Governed Surface Queue Guard` green. PR body: `Fixes #30273` present (L3), `Clause-②: no` (L4) and `Metadata-protocol: none` (L5) re-derived — no `packages/spec`, no error code, no published export touched, so both values are right. `skip-changeset` correct for a `.claude/**`-only diff; `Check Changeset` green. The first-line harness attribution HTML comment is the allowed exception (os-dev.md L320).
- Check-runs at the last poll: every non-skipped run green except `Type Check · consumer gates` still `in_progress` (rule-text-only diff; no red). The seat confirms it before landing.

### ② Semver level

None. No published package changes; no changeset owed (`skip-changeset`, `Check Changeset` success). Governed rule text only.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev deviation 1 (SKILL.md L223 unchanged): right. L221-223 is the conditional-ruling arm; its fork is "前提不成立就报 fork", triggered by a failed premise, not by a contract touch (SKILL.md L223). The shape/prose split has no purchase there; the card's L223 cite was a line pointer, not a second rule. The split is defined once (os-dev.md L350-352), and SKILL.md L217 plus execution-duties L130 point at the same boundary — no duplicate copy, consistent with os-dev.md L356 "框架唯一副本".
- Dev deviation 2 (example in `dispatch-runbook.md` 派发词构造细则): right — no order-template file exists; runbook L195 is the order-construction section, and the example sits beside the file-surface lines L214-216.
- Dev deviation 3 (deleted lines): answered in ① — all rationale-only or duplicated.
- `open_questions`: empty. Card grep over this PR's own surface: 4 non-⛔ hits none citing a ruling (reported in the PR body and the report); reviewed and agreed — the only constraint is the maintainer's 「skills 立卡」.
- PR author `user.login` = `objectstack-fleet[bot]`: no login note owed.

### ④ Design judgment

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md`: L12-13, L128-130 hold against the #30178 scenario (the grep at L12 would have surfaced A′ on `screen-input-contract.ts` L143; L128 would have refused the coerce route; L129 would have sent the "should A′ move?" question to a review thread before dispatch; L130 would have put the spec jsdoc/.describe sites in the fence). Consistent with landing-operations.md L9 (path arm still `packages/spec/src/**` non-test) and contract-review.md L7-9.
- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`: L350-352 are correct and tight. should-fix 1: L352 says the landing "欠契约复审档记录" for the whole prose group of L351, which includes `content/docs/**`; contract-review.md L8-9 says the `content/docs/**` prose face owes no at-tier record. In the targeted case the record is owed anyway by the `packages/spec/src/**` face (L7-8), so the two texts agree in practice; a later diet pass could word it as "the spec face owes the record" to close the content/docs-only edge. Not a must-fix: it over-asks, never under-asks, and the dev does not decide what is owed.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`: L217 one-word change; no other line moved; L162 untouched.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md`: L217-219 accurate (see ①); should-fix 2 (low): deleted old L124 of execution-duties dropped the PM-side pointer to where the model-resolution order lives; the authority is still reachable through os-dev.md L12-13, so no rule is lost, but a one-line pointer could return when headroom allows.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:派发单写“裁决区”前,席位要先在声明的文件面(源码 + 测试)里 grep `ruling` / `Ruling-ref` / `maintainer` / `⛔`,引到的裁决逐字带入;只有 grep 为空才能写“无裁决”,建议路线不得违背所载裁决。开发的停手规则把“契约”拆成形状(Zod 形状、错误码、可写键、公开导出:仍报 `needs_decision`)和散文(jsdoc、`.describe`、文档:只复述已载裁决时同 PR 改,PR 正文写裁决 id)。runbook 加了 #30178 的改写示例。
- 为什么改:#30178 的派发单漏带文件里引用了十次的裁决 A′,建议路线正好与之相反,卡停了 80 分钟;你在该线程说「skills 立卡」。
- 风险与回滚:4 个 `.claude/**` 文件各 +/− 等行,行数上限未动;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`.claude/agents/os-dev.md` 第 350–352 行和 `references/execution-duties.md` 第 12–13、128–130 行。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` 通过,四个文件行数与 main 相同。
- 需要你做的:无。`.claude/**` 为 Tier S,复核 PASS(6673000079)且 CI 全绿,席位直接入自动合并。
- 席位意见:可合。两条可选建议(os-dev L352 对纯 `content/docs/**` 多要了一份复核记录;删掉的模型解析指针可在有余量时补回)留给下次瘦身,不阻塞。
